cohort: Nulliparous women who either received or did not receive counseling for fear of childbirth during their first pregnancy
finding: Women who received counseling for fear of childbirth in their first pregnancy were less likely to have more than two children and more likely to have cesarean deliveries, less positive birth experiences, and subsequent counseling for fear of childbirth, suggesting that fear of childbirth is not easily treated.
mod_finding: Women who received counseling for fear of childbirth in their first pregnancy were more likely to have a cesarean delivery in their first and second childbirth.
